note: off-topic questions were written by the assistant (30, not human-curated); thresholds fitted on dev + half of them

scoped_calibration.note: 20 papers x 7 generic in-paper questions vs 8 off-topic questions (both written by the assistant); with a paper selected, generic questions score 0.72-0.78 so the global threshold (0.8225) would refuse all of them. 0.74 kept 94% of generic and refused 81% of off-topic questions; overview ('explain/summarize this paper') requests skip the gate. Revised to 0.72 after real use: at 0.74 even clear in-paper questions such as 'What did the authors find?' were refused for some papers (they score 0.73-0.74); 0.72 kept 99% of generic in-paper questions and refused 52% of off-topic ones on the same data, and the passages-only answer additionally requires word overlap with the question.
